fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Handcrafted Green Floral Ceramic Tile Double Wall Hook
fields.DESCRIPTION: Infuse your walls with the vibrant charm of Rajasthan with this handcrafted double wall hook. Featuring green ceramic tiles adorned with bright yellow floral motifs, this piece beautifully blends traditional artistry with functionality. The wrought iron frame ensures durability, while the glossy ceramic knobs provide a smooth finish for easy use. Perfect for hanging clothes, keys, bags, or accessories, this double hook is a practical yet artistic addition to your home décor.
